title: AgenticEvolve: Evolutionary Program Search with Persistent Language Model Agents that Design and Run Experiments
title_zh: AgenticEvolve：基于持久化语言模型智能体的进化程序搜索，自主设计与运行实验

paragraphs.en: Evolutionary program search with large language models keeps the structure of an evolutionary algorithm and uses the model as its variation operator. Typically, the model generates each candidate program in a single request from parent programs and their scores. We present AgenticEvolve, an evolutionary program search framework in which each island is run by a persistent large language model agent. Between evaluations, the agent designs and runs experiments on the candidate program. To measure the contribution of experimentation, we compare AgenticEvolve with No-analysis, an otherwise identical configuration with experiments disabled. On two heuristic design tasks with three large language models, AgenticEvolve produces better programs than No-analysis and OpenEvolve on both hidden and unseen instances. It reaches the baselines’ final quality with far fewer evaluations and comparable cost. On twelve equation discovery problems, it recovers the ground-truth structure of more equations than No-analysis and existing language-model and genetic programming baselines.

paragraphs.en: Genetic programming searches over programs with variation operators that recombine and mutate code without knowledge of what it computes [ 1 ] . Evolutionary program search with large language models (LLMs) retains the structure of the evolutionary algorithm and uses the model as its variation operator [ 2 ] . The search maintains a population of programs, prompts the model with one or more parents and their scores, and evaluates each returned program with an automated evaluator. FunSearch uses this approach to find new constructions in extremal combinatorics and a new online bin packing heuristic [ 3 ] , and AlphaEvolve extends it to algorithm and systems optimization [ 4 ] . Evolution of Heuristics and LLaMEA apply it to heuristic and metaheuristic design [ 5 , 6 ] . LLM-SR uses the same loop to discover scientific equations, represented as programs whose constants are fitted numerically [ 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 遗传编程通过对程序施加变异算子进行搜索，这些算子在不了解代码计算内容的情况下对代码进行重组和变异 [ 1 ] 。 基于大语言模型（LLM）的演化程序搜索保留了演化算法的结构，并将该模型用作其变异算子 [ 2 ] 。 该搜索维护一个程序种群，以一个或多个父代及其得分作为提示输入模型，并用自动化评估器评估每个返回的程序。 FunSearch 利用这种方法在极值组合学中找到了新的构造以及一种新的在线装箱启发式算法 [ 3 ] ，AlphaEvolve 则将其扩展到算法与系统优化 [ 4 ] 。 Evolution of Heuristics 和 LLaMEA 将其应用于启发式与元启发式设计 [ 5 , 6 ] 。 LLM-SR 使用同样的循环来发现科学方程，这些方程被表示为程序，其常数通过数值方法拟合 [ 7 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In these LLM-based systems, however, the model has no execution tools available during candidate generation. It reasons from the parent programs, their scores, and any textual feedback supplied in the prompt, such as reflections on earlier evaluations. Empirical information about program behavior enters the search only through formal evaluation. Each formal evaluation consumes budget, and its instances are often hidden from the model.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在这些基于大语言模型的系统中，模型在生成候选方案时没有任何可用的执行工具。 它仅根据父代程序、其得分以及提示中提供的任何文本反馈进行推理，例如对先前评估的反思。 关于程序行为的经验信息只能通过正式评估进入搜索过程。 每次正式评估都会消耗预算，且其实例通常对模型是隐藏的。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in LLM agents have enabled models to carry out multi-step tasks by interleaving reasoning with tool calls [ 8 ] . Coding agents use tools to edit files, run code, and inspect outputs iteratively to optimize program performance [ 9 , 10 ] . Within evolutionary search, such an agent can experiment between formal evaluations: it can generate instances, measure program behavior, fit parameters and test changes locally before submitting a candidate. These experiments can support local improvement and surrogate evaluation, both of which have long been combined with global search in evolutionary computation [ 11 , 12 ] . Recent work has also used persistent agents for program search [ 13 ] and ablated diagnostic or data-analysis tools in heuristic design and equation discovery [ 14 , 15 ] . In this paper, we ask how much self-designed experiments improve program quality when the other evolutionary mechanisms remain fixed, what resources they require, and how their benefits and costs vary across tasks and models.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型智能体的最新进展使模型能够通过将推理与工具调用交替进行来执行多步任务 [ 8 ]。 编程智能体使用工具来编辑文件、运行代码并迭代地检查输出，以优化程序性能 [ 9 , 10 ]。 在进化搜索中，这样的智能体可以在正式评估之间进行实验：它可以生成实例、测量程序行为、拟合参数，并在提交候选方案之前在本地测试改动。 这些实验可以支持局部改进和代理评估，而这两者在进化计算中长期以来一直与全局搜索相结合 [ 11 , 12 ]。 最近的工作还将持久化智能体用于程序搜索 [ 13 ]，并在启发式设计和方程发现中对诊断或数据分析工具进行了消融研究 [ 14 , 15 ]。 在本文中，我们探讨在其他进化机制保持不变的情况下，自主设计的实验能在多大程度上提升程序质量、它们需要多少资源，以及其收益和成本在不同任务和模型之间如何变化。

paragraphs.en: This paper presents AgenticEvolve, an evolutionary program search framework in which each island is run by a persistent LLM agent. Throughout the search, the agent maintains a conversation in which it edits the candidate program, writes and executes custom analysis scripts between commits, and submits candidates for formal evaluation through a commit tool. Committed programs enter a MAP-Elites archive [ 16 ] , and islands exchange elite programs through periodic migration. A No-analysis configuration removes the analysis tool and leaves everything else unchanged, which isolates the contribution of the agent’s experiments. We evaluate this contribution across two regimes: heuristic design on online bin packing and dynamic job shop scheduling, where formal evaluation instances are hidden and the agent must generate its own test instances, and scientific equation discovery on twelve problems from LLM-SRBench [ 17 ] , where training data are available for direct analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出 AgenticEvolve，一个演化式程序搜索框架，其中每个岛由一个持久化的大语言模型智能体负责运行。 在整个搜索过程中，该智能体通过对话进行操作：编辑候选程序，在提交之间编写并执行自定义分析脚本，并通过提交工具提交候选程序以进行正式评估。 已提交的程序进入 MAP-Elites 档案库 [ 16 ]，各岛之间通过周期性迁移交换精英程序。 无分析（No-analysis）配置移除了分析工具，其余一切保持不变，从而隔离出智能体实验的贡献。 我们在两种场景下评估这一贡献：一是在在线装箱问题和动态作业车间调度问题上的启发式设计，其中正式评估实例是隐藏的，智能体必须自行生成测试实例；二是基于 LLM-SRBench [ 17 ] 十二个问题的科学方程发现，其中训练数据可直接用于分析。

paragraphs.en: FunSearch, AlphaEvolve and OpenEvolve search over programs with an evolutionary outer loop and an LLM as the variation operator. FunSearch keeps a database of programs organized in islands and samples high-scoring programs into the prompt [ 3 ] . AlphaEvolve extends the search to open mathematical problems and to the optimization of compute stacks [ 4 ] . OpenEvolve, the baseline in Section V , is an open-source system that follows this approach, with a MAP-Elites archive, multiple islands with periodic migration, and prompts containing parent and inspiration programs [ 18 ] . For heuristic design, Evolution of Heuristics evolves natural-language ideas together with code under fixed prompt strategies [ 5 ] , ReEvo adds reflections on evaluation results [ 20 ] , and LLaMEA mutates complete metaheuristics in a (1+1) scheme driven by performance feedback [ 6 ] . ShinkaEvolve refines the outer loop through parent sampling, novelty-based candidate rejection and adaptive model selection [ 21 ] . In their default configurations, these systems generate each candidate in a single model request without execution tools. AgenticEvolve retains population-based search, archives and islands, while a persistent agent develops candidates through experiments between formal evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: FunSearch、AlphaEvolve 和 OpenEvolve 以进化外环并使用大语言模型作为变异算子在程序空间中进行搜索。 FunSearch 维护一个按岛屿组织的程序数据库，并将高分程序采样后放入提示词 [ 3 ] 。 AlphaEvolve 将搜索扩展到开放的数学问题以及计算栈的优化 [ 4 ] 。 OpenEvolve 是第 V 节中的基线系统，它是一个遵循该方法的开源系统，采用 MAP-Elites 归档、多个定期迁移的岛屿，以及包含父代程序和灵感程序的提示词 [ 18 ] 。 在启发式设计方面，Evolution of Heuristics 在固定的提示策略下同时进化自然语言想法和代码 [ 5 ] ，ReEvo 增加了对评估结果的反思 [ 20 ] ，而 LLaMEA 在性能反馈驱动的 (1+1) 方案中对完整的元启发式算法进行变异 [ 6 ] 。 ShinkaEvolve 通过父代采样、基于新颖性的候选拒绝以及自适应模型选择来改进外环 [ 21 ] 。 在默认配置下，这些系统在单次模型请求中生成每个候选程序，而不使用执行工具。 AgenticEvolve 保留了基于种群的搜索、归档和岛屿机制，同时由一个持久化的智能体在正式评估之间通过实验来开发候选程序。

sents.zh: 在启发式设计方面，Evolution of Heuristics 在固定的提示策略下同时进化自然语言想法和代码 [ 5 ] ，ReEvo 增加了对评估结果的反思 [ 20 ] ，而 LLaMEA 在性能反馈驱动的 (1+1) 方案中对完整的元启发式算法进行变异 [ 6 ] 。

sents.en: ShinkaEvolve refines the outer loop through parent sampling, novelty-based candidate rejection and adaptive model selection [ 21 ] .
sents.zh: ShinkaEvolve 通过父代采样、基于新颖性的候选拒绝以及自适应模型选择来改进外环 [ 21 ] 。

sents.en: In their default configurations, these systems generate each candidate in a single model request without execution tools.
sents.zh: 在默认配置下，这些系统在单次模型请求中生成每个候选程序，而不使用执行工具。

sents.en: AgenticEvolve retains population-based search, archives and islands, while a persistent agent develops candidates through experiments between formal evaluations.
sents.zh: AgenticEvolve 保留了基于种群的搜索、归档和岛屿机制，同时由一个持久化的智能体在正式评估之间通过实验来开发候选程序。

paragraphs.en: Agentic search methods differ in how much control they give the agent over the search. AlgoTune uses a general coding agent to speed up numerical programs without maintaining a population [ 10 ] . CORAL runs persistent coding agents against a hidden grader. The agents can inspect all previous attempts and choose their own parents. The study reports a correlation between local verification and improvement, but does not ablate execution [ 13 ] . AVO uses an autonomous coding agent as the variation operator in evolutionary search and evaluates it in a multi-day run on attention-kernel optimization [ 22 ] . ReASearch and SimpleEvol remove the external search controller, using a single agent that decides what to evaluate [ 23 ] and an agent loop with minimal human priors [ 24 ] , respectively. AgenticEvolve combines persistent agents with population-based search, MAP-Elites archives and periodic migration.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式搜索方法的区别在于它们赋予智能体对搜索过程多大的控制权。 AlgoTune 使用一个通用编码智能体来加速数值程序，且不维护种群 [ 10 ] 。 CORAL 让持久化的编码智能体针对一个隐藏的评分器运行。 这些智能体可以查看之前所有的尝试，并自行选择父代。 该研究报告了局部验证与改进之间的相关性，但没有对执行环节进行消融实验 [ 13 ] 。 AVO 将一个自主编码智能体用作进化搜索中的变异算子，并在注意力内核优化任务上进行了为期数天的运行评估 [ 22 ] 。 ReASearch 和 SimpleEvol 则去掉了外部搜索控制器，分别使用由单个智能体自行决定评估什么的方案 [ 23 ] ，以及带有最少人类先验的智能体循环 [ 24 ] 。 AgenticEvolve 将持久化智能体与基于种群的搜索、MAP-Elites 档案和周期性迁移相结合。

paragraphs.en: These methods also differ in the information agents can obtain between evaluations. AHD Agent provides two predefined read-only diagnostic tools, and an ablation in its appendix shows that they lower the agent’s optimality gap by one to two points [ 14 ] . Removing ReASearch’s Python execution tool reduces its accuracy on ARC-AGI-2 by a third [ 23 ] . Vesper places coding agents with file-system access inside evolutionary search. At a fixed token budget, it finds that allocating more reasoning to fewer candidates outperforms generating more candidates [ 25 ] . In AgenticEvolve, the model writes its own experiments for the current candidate. We measure their contribution through the No-analysis configuration, which disables this capability while retaining the other search settings, and report both model costs and formal evaluation counts.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法在智能体在两次评估之间能够获取的信息方面也有所不同。 AHD Agent 提供两个预定义的只读诊断工具，其附录中的消融实验表明，这些工具能将智能体的最优性差距降低一到两个百分点 [ 14 ] 。 移除 ReASearch 的 Python 执行工具会使其在 ARC-AGI-2 上的准确率降低三分之一 [ 23 ] 。 Vesper 将具有文件系统访问权限的编程智能体置于进化搜索之中。 在固定的 token 预算下，它发现将更多推理分配给更少的候选方案优于生成更多候选方案 [ 25 ] 。 在 AgenticEvolve 中，模型会为当前候选方案自行编写实验。 我们通过 No-analysis 配置来衡量其贡献，该配置在保留其他搜索设置的同时禁用这一能力，并报告模型成本和正式评估次数。

paragraphs.en: Scientific equation discovery is commonly cast as symbolic regression, and research on it spans genetic programming, LLM-based program evolution and agentic search. PySR searches expression trees with multi-population genetic programming [ 19 ] , and LaSR adds LLM-guided operators and a library of natural-language concepts to this search [ 26 ] . LLM-SR uses a language model to propose equation skeletons as programs and fits their constants numerically [ 7 ] . Deliberate Evolution adds structure diagnosis, adaptive operators and reflective memory to this loop [ 27 ] . SR-Scientist equips a single agent with a data analysis tool and an equation evaluator, and maintains a memory of candidate equations [ 15 ] . Removing the data analysis tool reduces the fraction of problems fitted within a tolerance of 0.01 from 63.6% to 35.7% for one model, with smaller reductions for two others. LLM-SRBench, from which our problems are drawn, evaluates numerical accuracy and uses an LLM to judge symbolic accuracy [ 17 ] . Section VI compares AgenticEvolve and No-analysis with PySR, LLM-SR and SR-Scientist.

paragraphs.en: AgenticEvolve organizes program search across multiple concurrently running islands (Fig. 1 ). Each island is run by a persistent LLM agent, which maintains a conversation with the framework throughout the search. The agent uses tools to inspect and modify a candidate program, to run experiments on it and to commit it for formal evaluation. The framework evaluates every committed program, records it in an archive and returns the result to the agent together with a summary of the archive, which periodically includes elite programs from the neighboring islands.
paragraphs.zh: AgenticEvolve 在多个并发运行的岛之间组织程序搜索（图 1）。 每个岛由一个持久运行的 LLM 智能体负责，该智能体在整个搜索过程中与框架保持对话。 该智能体使用工具来检查和修改候选程序、在候选程序上运行实验，并将其提交以进行正式评估。 框架会评估每一个被提交的程序，将其记录到档案中，并把结果连同档案摘要一起返回给智能体，该摘要会定期包含来自相邻岛的精英程序。

paragraphs.en: AgenticEvolve searches for a program that maximizes fitness within a fixed budget. A task is specified by a natural-language description of the problem, an initial program and an evaluator. The evaluator executes a candidate and returns its fitness together with task-defined features, which determine its position in the archive of Section III-C . A task may also provide data for the agent’s experiments. Every island starts from the same initial program. At the end of a run, the framework returns the program with the highest fitness among the successfully evaluated commits from all islands.
paragraphs.zh: AgenticEvolve 在固定预算内搜索使适应度最大化的程序。 一个任务由问题的自然语言描述、一个初始程序和一个评估器来指定。 评估器执行候选程序并返回其适应度以及任务定义的特征，这些特征决定了它在第 III-C 节档案中的位置。 任务还可以为智能体的实验提供数据。 每个岛屿都从同一个初始程序开始。 在一次运行结束时，框架返回所有岛屿中成功评估的提交里适应度最高的程序。

paragraphs.en: The conversation of an island begins with a system prompt that describes the task, explains the feedback the agent will receive and lists the files and tools available to it. The first message contains the initial program, its evaluation result and the budget. Afterwards the framework only returns the results of tool calls and prompts the agent to continue whenever it ends a turn. The accumulated conversation thus provides the agent with a record of previous program revisions, experiments and evaluation results on which to base subsequent decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 一个岛屿的对话始于一段系统提示词，该提示词描述任务、解释智能体将获得的反馈，并列出可供其使用的文件和工具。 第一条消息包含初始程序、其评估结果以及预算。 此后，框架只返回工具调用的结果，并在智能体结束一轮对话时提示其继续。 这样累积起来的对话为智能体提供了以往程序修订、实验和评估结果的记录，作为其后续决策的依据。

paragraphs.en: The agent inspects and modifies the candidate with three file tools, read , write and edit , which operate on program.py . Between two commits it can also run experiments on the candidate. It writes a second file, analysis.py , which can import the current program, and executes this script with the tool run_analysis . We refer to each such execution as an analysis. The framework runs the script in a working directory that contains the program, the script and the data provided by the task, if any, and returns the printed output to the conversation. The evaluator and its hidden inputs are not available in this directory. After reading the output, the agent revises the program or the script, runs another analysis, or commits the program. The agent decides what to investigate, how many analyses to run and what to change, subject only to a limit on the number of analyses per commit.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体使用三个文件工具 read、write 和 edit 来检查和修改候选程序，这些工具作用于 program.py。 在两次提交之间，它还可以对候选程序运行实验。 它会编写第二个文件 analysis.py，该文件可以导入当前程序，并使用工具 run_analysis 执行此脚本。 我们将每次这样的执行称为一次分析。 框架在一个工作目录中运行该脚本，该目录包含程序、脚本以及任务提供的数据（如有），并将打印的输出返回到对话中。 评估器及其隐藏输入在此目录中不可用。 阅读输出后，智能体会修改程序或脚本、运行另一次分析，或提交程序。 智能体决定调查什么、运行多少次分析以及更改什么，仅受每次提交的分析次数上限的约束。

paragraphs.en: The tool commit submits the current program.py for formal evaluation. Each submission consumes one unit of the evaluation budget, including submissions that fail. paragraphs.en: The archive records every commit from all islands, including failed evaluations, with its source code, evaluation result and the description written by the agent. Each island maintains a MAP-Elites grid [ 16 ] over the features computed by the evaluator, such as program complexity. Each feature is divided into uniform bins, and a successfully evaluated program is assigned to a cell according to its feature values. The program enters the cell if the cell is empty or if its fitness is higher than that of the current occupant. The archive summary returned after each commit lists the island’s best program and its grid elites, each given by its identifier, metrics and description.
paragraphs.zh: 归档记录来自所有岛屿的每次提交，包括失败的评估，并连同其源代码、评估结果以及智能体撰写的描述。 每个岛屿维护一个 MAP-Elites 网格 [ 16 ]，该网格基于评估器计算的特征，例如程序复杂度。 每个特征被划分为均匀的分箱，成功评估的程序根据其特征值被分配到一个单元格中。 如果该单元格为空，或者程序的适应度高于当前占据者的适应度，则该程序进入该单元格。 每次提交后返回的归档摘要列出该岛屿的最佳程序及其网格精英，每个程序由其标识符、指标和描述给出。

paragraphs.en: The islands are arranged in a ring and exchange elite programs through periodic migration [ 28 ] . paragraphs.en: The evaluation result returned by commit is restricted. A successful evaluation returns the task-defined metrics. paragraphs.en: We compare AgenticEvolve with No-analysis, an otherwise identical configuration without experiments. No-analysis removes run_analysis from the available tools, disables access to analysis.py and removes the corresponding instructions from the system prompt. The persistent conversation, program editing, formal evaluation, archive, migration, compaction and budget remain unchanged. Candidate programs are still executed at each commit, with the restricted feedback described above. The difference between the two configurations therefore measures the contribution of the agent’s experiments.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate AgenticEvolve on two heuristic design tasks, online bin packing (OBP) and dynamic job shop scheduling (DJSS). We chose these tasks because the instances used for formal evaluation are hidden from the agent, while the task description specifies their generating process. The agent’s experiments therefore cannot reproduce the formal evaluation, and any benefit of analysis must come from instances that the agent generates itself. In Section VI we extend the study to symbolic regression, where the agent is given the training data and its experiments can reproduce the training score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个启发式设计任务上评估 AgenticEvolve：在线装箱（OBP）和动态作业车间调度（DJSS）。 我们选择这些任务，是因为用于正式评估的实例对智能体是隐藏的，而任务描述规定了这些实例的生成过程。 因此，智能体的实验无法复现正式评估，任何来自分析的收益都必须源于智能体自己生成的实例。 在第六节中，我们将研究扩展到符号回归，在该任务中智能体可以获得训练数据，其实验可以复现训练得分。

paragraphs.en: OBP follows the setting of FunSearch [ 3 ] . Items arrive one at a time and must be placed irrevocably. The candidate program scores the feasible bins for the current item, and the item is placed in the bin with the highest score. The initial program is Best Fit, which places the item in the feasible bin with the least remaining capacity. The description states the instance distribution, sequences of 120 items with integer sizes drawn uniformly from [ 20,100 ] [20,100] and bins of capacity 150. The hidden evaluation set contains 100 such sequences. The evaluator computes the fractional excess e e of the total number of bins used over the sum of the Martello–Toth L 2 L_{2} lower bounds [ 29 ] and returns the fitness 1 / ( 1 + e ) 1/(1+e) . We report quality as this excess in percent. Generalization is tested on the 20 instances of OR1 from the OR-Library [ 30 ] , which follow the same size distribution, and on 100 new sequences drawn from the stated distribution. Best Fit and the heuristic reported by FunSearch serve as references.

paragraphs.en: DJSS follows the simulation setting of Ferreira et al. [ 31 ] . Jobs arrive according to a Poisson process at a shop with ten machines. Each job has two to fourteen operations with integer processing times drawn uniformly from [ 1 , 99 ] [1,99] , and consecutive operations visit different machines. Its due date is the arrival time plus an allowance factor times the total processing time. The candidate program is a dispatching rule. Whenever a machine becomes free, the rule scores its waiting operations based on job attributes and the current shop state. The operation with the highest score starts next. The initial program is the shortest processing time rule. The evaluation uses five scenarios combining utilization 0.85 with allowance factors 2 and 4, and utilization 0.95 with factors 2, 4 and 6. Each scenario uses ten hidden seeds. The combination of utilization 0.85 and allowance 6 is excluded because its tardiness is close to zero. In each simulation, the first 500 jobs form the warm-up period, and the mean tardiness of the following 2000 jobs is recorded. For each scenario, this value is averaged over the seeds and divided by the corresponding mean for rule R1 of Ferreira et al. Quality is the geometric mean of these ratios over the five scenarios, and the fitness is its reciprocal. Generalization is tested on the same five scenarios with ten new seeds, so it covers new arrival streams but not new scenarios. R1 is the reference and has quality 1 by construction.
paragraphs.zh: DJSS 遵循 Ferreira 等人 [ 31 ] 的仿真设置。 作业按泊松过程到达一个拥有十台机器的车间。 每个作业包含两到十四道工序，其整数加工时间从 [ 1 , 99 ] [1,99] 中均匀抽取，且相邻工序访问不同的机器。 作业的交货期是到达时间加上容许因子与总加工时间的乘积。 候选程序是一个派工规则。 每当一台机器空闲时，该规则会基于作业属性和当前车间状态对其等待中的工序进行打分。 得分最高的工序下一个开始。 初始程序是最短加工时间规则。 评估使用五个场景，分别是利用率 0.85 与容许因子 2 和 4 的组合，以及利用率 0.95 与因子 2、4 和 6 的组合。 每个场景使用十个隐藏种子。 利用率 0.85 与容许因子 6 的组合被排除，因为其拖期接近于零。 在每次仿真中，前 500 个作业构成预热期，随后 2000 个作业的平均拖期被记录下来。 对于每个场景，该值在各个种子上取平均，再除以 Ferreira 等人的规则 R1 的相应平均值。 质量是这些比值在五个场景上的几何平均，适应度是其倒数。 泛化在相同的五个场景上用十个新种子进行测试，因此它覆盖新的到达流但不覆盖新场景。 R1 是参照，其质量按构造即为 1。

sents.zh: 得分最高的工序下一个开始。

sents.en: The initial program is the shortest processing time rule.
sents.zh: 初始程序是最短加工时间规则。

sents.en: The evaluation uses five scenarios combining utilization 0.85 with allowance factors 2 and 4, and utilization 0.95 with factors 2, 4 and 6.
sents.zh: 评估使用五个场景，分别是利用率 0.85 与容许因子 2 和 4 的组合，以及利用率 0.95 与因子 2、4 和 6 的组合。

sents.en: Each scenario uses ten hidden seeds.
sents.zh: 每个场景使用十个隐藏种子。

sents.en: The combination of utilization 0.85 and allowance 6 is excluded because its tardiness is close to zero.
sents.zh: 利用率 0.85 与容许因子 6 的组合被排除，因为其拖期接近于零。

sents.en: In each simulation, the first 500 jobs form the warm-up period, and the mean tardiness of the following 2000 jobs is recorded.
sents.zh: 在每次仿真中，前 500 个作业构成预热期，随后 2000 个作业的平均拖期被记录下来。

sents.en: For each scenario, this value is averaged over the seeds and divided by the corresponding mean for rule R1 of Ferreira et al.
sents.zh: 对于每个场景，该值在各个种子上取平均，再除以 Ferreira 等人的规则 R1 的相应平均值。

sents.en: Quality is the geometric mean of these ratios over the five scenarios, and the fitness is its reciprocal.
sents.zh: 质量是这些比值在五个场景上的几何平均，适应度是其倒数。

sents.en: Generalization is tested on the same five scenarios with ten new seeds, so it covers new arrival streams but not new scenarios.
sents.zh: 泛化在相同的五个场景上用十个新种子进行测试，因此它覆盖新的到达流但不覆盖新场景。

sents.en: R1 is the reference and has quality 1 by construction.
sents.zh: R1 是参照，其质量按构造即为 1。

paragraphs.en: AgenticEvolve may run up to ten analyses per commit. No-analysis is the configuration of Section III-D . The baseline is OpenEvolve [ 18 ] , an open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve [ 4 ] . In each iteration OpenEvolve samples a parent and several reference programs from the current island and asks the LLM to modify the parent in a single request. We retain this search mechanism and align the remaining settings with AgenticEvolve. Both systems use three islands, the same MAP-Elites features with ten bins each, the same task description and initial program, the same evaluator and executor with the same evaluation time limit, and the same model, reasoning effort and output limit. OpenEvolve receives the task description as its system message. Changes to OpenEvolve’s default settings, such as a migration interval short enough to take effect within a run, are listed and justified in Section S1-B of the supplementary material.
paragraphs.zh: AgenticEvolve 在每次提交时最多可运行十次分析。 No-analysis（无分析）是第 III-D 节中的配置。 基线是 OpenEvolve [ 18 ] ，它是 AlphaEvolve [ 4 ] 的一个开源实现。 在每次迭代中，OpenEvolve 从当前岛屿中采样一个父程序和若干参考程序，并要求大语言模型在单次请求中修改该父程序。 我们保留了这一搜索机制，并使其余设置与 AgenticEvolve 保持一致。 两个系统都使用三个岛屿、相同的 MAP-Elites 特征（每个特征十个分箱）、相同的任务描述和初始程序、相同的评估器和执行器（具有相同的评估时限），以及相同的模型、推理力度和输出限制。 OpenEvolve 将任务描述作为其系统消息接收。 对 OpenEvolve 默认设置的更改（例如足够短的迁移间隔以使其在单次运行内生效）在补充材料的第 S1-B 节中列出并说明理由。

paragraphs.en: Each method is run five times with each model. The runs are independent, so all comparisons are unpaired. Differences in final quality are tested with a two-sided Mann–Whitney U U test at the 0.05 level, using an exact calculation when there are no ties and an asymptotic approximation otherwise. With five runs per group, the smallest attainable exact p p value is 0.008. Effect sizes are reported as differences in means with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals. We report p p values without correction. A Holm correction applied to the three comparisons within each task and model would not alter the significance of any difference in final quality.
paragraphs.zh: 每种方法与每个模型组合均运行五次。 各次运行相互独立，因此所有比较均为非配对比较。 最终质量的差异采用双尾 Mann–Whitney U 检验在 0.05 水平上进行检验，当不存在并列值时使用精确计算，否则使用渐近近似。 每组五次运行时，可达到的最小精确 p 值为 0.008。 效应量以均值差异报告，并附带 bootstrap 95% 置信区间。 我们报告未经校正的 p 值。 对每个任务和模型内的三次比较应用 Holm 校正，不会改变最终质量任何差异的显著性。

paragraphs.en: Tasks, budgets and stopping conditions were fixed before the formal runs, and a run was repeated only after an infrastructure failure. The heuristic runs predate the feedback restriction of Section III-D , so for all three methods the feedback of a failed evaluation included the truncated output and traceback. An audit of these runs (Section S4-A) found no access to the evaluator or the hidden instances.
paragraphs.zh: 任务、预算和停止条件在正式运行前就已固定，只有在基础设施故障时才会重复运行。 启发式运行早于第 III-D 节的反馈限制，因此对这三种方法而言，评估失败的反馈都包含了截断的输出和回溯信息。 对这些运行的审计（第 S4-A 节）未发现任何访问评估器或隐藏实例的情况。

paragraphs.en: Table II and Fig. 2 report the quality of each run’s final program on the hidden evaluation set and on unseen instances. On the hidden set, AgenticEvolve has the best mean quality with every model on both tasks. Across the three models, it reduces the OBP excess over the L 2 L_{2} bound by 1.8 to 2.3 percentage points compared with No-analysis and by 1.1 to 2.4 points compared with OpenEvolve. On DJSS it reduces R1-normalized tardiness by 0.08 to 0.16 compared with No-analysis and by 0.07 to 0.16 compared with OpenEvolve. The confidence intervals of all twelve differences exclude zero (Section S2-A). Nine of the differences are significant, the exceptions being No-analysis on DJSS with GLM and OpenEvolve on DJSS with DeepSeek and on OBP with GLM. No difference between No-analysis and OpenEvolve is significant with any model on either task.
paragraphs.zh: 表II和图2报告了各次运行的最终程序在隐藏评估集和未见实例上的质量。 在隐藏集上，AgenticEvolve在两个任务中使用每个模型都取得了最佳的平均质量。 在三个模型上，与No-analysis相比，它将超出L 2 L_{2}界的OBP超额降低了1.8到2.3个百分点；与OpenEvolve相比，降低了1.1到2.4个百分点。 在DJSS上，与No-analysis相比，它将R1归一化延误降低了0.08到0.16；与OpenEvolve相比，降低了0.07到0.16。 全部十二个差值的置信区间均不包含零（第S2-A节）。 其中有九个差值是显著的，例外情况是No-analysis在DJSS上使用GLM，以及OpenEvolve在DJSS上使用DeepSeek和在OBP上使用GLM。 在任一任务上使用任一模型，No-analysis与OpenEvolve之间均无显著差异。

paragraphs.en: The improvements carry over to instances that no method has seen. AgenticEvolve has the lowest mean on every unseen set with every model, and the confidence interval of its difference from either other method excludes zero in every case (Section S2-A). On OR1, AgenticEvolve’s mean excess over the L 2 L_{2} bound ranges from 2.9 to 4.1 percent across models, compared with 5.3 percent for the FunSearch heuristic and 5.8 percent for Best Fit. The corresponding means for No-analysis and OpenEvolve range from 5.0 to 5.6 percent, close to the FunSearch heuristic. The fresh sequences from the training distribution give the same picture. On the fresh DJSS seeds, AgenticEvolve achieves mean R1-normalized tardiness of 0.84 to 0.86 across models, compared with 0.92 to 1.00 for the other two methods.
paragraphs.zh: 这些改进能够延续到任何方法都未曾见过的实例上。 AgenticEvolve 在每个未见过的数据集上、使用每个模型时都具有最低的均值，且其与其他任一方法之差的置信区间在所有情况下都不包含零（第 S2-A 节）。 在 OR1 上，AgenticEvolve 相对于 L 2 L_{2} 下界的平均超出量在不同模型间为 2.9% 到 4.1%，而 FunSearch 启发式为 5.3%，Best Fit 为 5.8%。 No-analysis 和 OpenEvolve 对应的均值在 5.0% 到 5.6% 之间，接近 FunSearch 启发式。 来自训练分布的新序列呈现出相同的情形。 在新的 DJSS 种子上，AgenticEvolve 在各模型下的平均 R1 归一化拖期时间为 0.84 到 0.86，而另外两种方法为 0.92 到 1.00。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 3 plots the best quality found so far against the number of formal evaluations. The horizontal axis does not count analyses. AgenticEvolve uses formal evaluations most efficiently on both tasks with every model. Its curve separates from the other two within the first ten evaluations and stays ahead to the end of its budget. In five of the six cases, AgenticEvolve reaches OpenEvolve’s final quality within 20 evaluations, compared with OpenEvolve’s 180-iteration runs (Section S2-B). No-analysis and OpenEvolve have no separate analysis tool, and their curves remain close over the common range of 91 evaluations. On DJSS the two curves overlap with all three models. On OBP, No-analysis is slightly ahead of OpenEvolve with DeepSeek and Qwen, and slightly behind with GLM.
paragraphs.zh: 图3绘制了迄今为止找到的最佳质量与正式评估次数之间的关系。 横轴不计入分析次数。 在两个任务上，AgenticEvolve 对所有模型都能最高效地使用正式评估。 其曲线在前十次评估内就与其余两条曲线拉开差距，并一直领先至预算耗尽。 在六种情况中的五种里，AgenticEvolve 在 20 次评估内就达到了 OpenEvolve 的最终质量，而 OpenEvolve 需要 180 次迭代的运行（见第 S2-B 节）。 无分析版本和 OpenEvolve 没有独立的分析工具，在 91 次评估的共同范围内，二者的曲线始终保持接近。 在 DJSS 上，两条曲线在所有三个模型下均相互重叠。 在 OBP 上，无分析版本在使用 DeepSeek 和 Qwen 时略优于 OpenEvolve，在使用 GLM 时则略逊于 OpenEvolve。

paragraphs.en: The equal-cost comparison with No-analysis depends on the task. On OBP, AgenticEvolve achieves better quality with every model, and the gap widens as the budget grows. paragraphs.en: The composition of the cost explains the dependence on the model. With DeepSeek, OpenEvolve generates an average of 15 to 27 thousand output tokens per request, mostly from extended reasoning in the absence of execution tools, compared with about one thousand for AgenticEvolve. This output dominates OpenEvolve’s cost. Its responses are much shorter with Qwen (4.6 to 11.1 thousand tokens per request) and GLM (2.5 to 4.8 thousand), and OpenEvolve is cheaper with these models. AgenticEvolve incurs input costs throughout the search as it repeatedly sends the growing conversation. Although 99% of these input tokens are cached, the higher cache-read prices of Qwen and GLM make repeated input the dominant expense, accounting for approximately 78% and 87% of AgenticEvolve’s cost, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 成本构成解释了对模型的依赖性。 使用 DeepSeek 时，OpenEvolve 每次请求平均生成 1.5 万至 2.7 万个输出 token，主要来自在没有执行工具的情况下进行的扩展推理，而 AgenticEvolve 约为一千个。 这一输出主导了 OpenEvolve 的成本。 使用 Qwen（每次请求 4,600 至 11,100 个 token）和 GLM（2,500 至 4,800 个）时，其响应要短得多，因此 OpenEvolve 在这些模型上更便宜。 AgenticEvolve 在整个搜索过程中都会产生输入成本，因为它反复发送不断增长的对话。 尽管这些输入 token 中有 99% 被缓存，但 Qwen 和 GLM 较高的缓存读取价格使重复输入成为主要开销，分别约占 AgenticEvolve 成本的 78% 和 87%。

paragraphs.en: The agent first examined where Best Fit wastes capacity. It generated 400 sequences from the stated distribution, checked that the excess of Best Fit on them was close to its formal value, and recorded the remaining capacity of each used bin at the end of each sequence. Bins left with less than 20 units, which no item can fill, accounted for 58% of the total waste. The agent then estimated the expected final waste U ⁡ ( L ) U(L) of a bin with current remaining capacity L L under the rule it was testing (Fig. 5 ). Below 20 the estimate equals L L itself. Above 20 it falls quickly to between 7 and 11 units and remains in that range at the larger capacities observed.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体首先考察了最佳适配（Best Fit）在哪些地方浪费了容量。 它从所述分布中生成 400 个序列，检验了最佳适配在这些序列上的超额量是否接近其理论值，并在每个序列结束时记录每个已用箱的剩余容量。 剩余不足 20 单位、任何物品都无法填入的箱，占总浪费的 58%。 该智能体随后估计了在其所测试规则下、当前剩余容量为 L L 的箱的期望最终浪费 U ⁡ ( L ) U(L)（图 5）。 在 20 以下，该估计值等于 L L 本身。 在 20 以上，该估计值迅速下降到 7 至 11 单位之间，并在所观察到的更大容量下保持在该范围内。

paragraphs.en: The agent turned this estimate into a placement rule and tested it before committing. Placing an item of size s s into a bin with remaining capacity L L changes the expected waste of that bin from U ⁡ ( L ) U(L) to U ⁡ ( L − s ) U(L-s) . The rule scores each feasible bin by U ⁡ ( L ) − U ⁡ ( L − s ) U(L)-U(L-s) , adds a small Best Fit term to break ties, and selects the highest-scoring bin. The agent represented U U by 13 interpolation knots and adjusted their values by coordinate descent on its 400 sequences. The adjustment preserved the broadly flat shape above 20 and lowered the values below it (Fig. 5 ). On four sets of self-generated sequences the excess fell from 6.3 to 6.6% under Best Fit to 5.4 to 5.7% under the new rule. On the hidden set the committed program reduced the excess from 6.553% to 5.392%. Section S2-C lists the ten analyses with their results and gives the committed program.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体将这一估计转化为一条放置规则，并在提交前进行了测试。将一个尺寸为 s s 的物品放入剩余容量为 L L 的箱中，会使该箱的预期浪费从 U ⁡ ( L ) U(L) 变为 U ⁡ ( L − s ) U(L-s)。该规则用 U ⁡ ( L ) − U ⁡ ( L − s ) U(L)-U(L-s) 为每个可行箱打分，并加入一个小的最佳适配（Best Fit）项以打破平局，然后选择得分最高的箱。该智能体用 13 个插值节点来表示 U U，并通过在其 400 个序列上进行坐标下降法来调整这些节点的值。调整后保留了 20 以上的大致平坦形状，并降低了 20 以下的值（图 5）。在四组自生成的序列上，超出率从最佳适配下的 6.3% 到 6.6% 降至新规则下的 5.4% 到 5.7%。在隐藏集上，提交后的程序将超出率从 6.553% 降至 5.392%。第 S2-C 节列出了这十项分析及其结果，并给出了提交后的程序。

paragraphs.en: The second experiment evaluates AgenticEvolve on symbolic regression, where the candidate program represents a mathematical expression fitted to data. Methods with analysis tools have access to the training data, so AgenticEvolve can fit and score a candidate during analysis using the same data as the evaluator. The in-domain and out-of-domain test sets are hidden and used only for reporting. We compare AgenticEvolve and No-analysis with LLM-SR [ 7 ] and SR-Scientist [ 15 ] , two LLM-based symbolic regression systems, and with PySR [ 19 ] , a genetic programming system, on twelve problems from LLM-SRBench [ 17 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 第二个实验在符号回归上评估 AgenticEvolve，其中候选程序表示一个拟合数据的数学表达式。 带分析工具的方法可以访问训练数据，因此 AgenticEvolve 在分析过程中可以使用与评估器相同的数据来拟合并为候选程序评分。 域内和域外测试集是隐藏的，仅用于报告结果。 我们在来自 LLM-SRBench [17] 的十二个问题上，将 AgenticEvolve 和 No-analysis 与两个基于 LLM 的符号回归系统 LLM-SR [7] 和 SR-Scientist [15]，以及遗传编程系统 PySR [19] 进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The twelve problems comprise all LSR-Synth problems that satisfy three criteria fixed before the runs: the complexity of the ground-truth expression lies within the interquartile range for its domain, the out-of-domain test split is informative, and removing any term from the ground truth and refitting the remaining terms gives a normalized mean squared error (NMSE) above 10 − 3 10^{-3} on the training data. The selection contains two chemistry problems (CRK21, CRK35), one biology problem (BPG18), six physics problems (PO0, PO1, PO7, PO10, PO16, PO26) and three material-science problems (MatSci6, MatSci9, MatSci11).
paragraphs.zh: 这十二个问题涵盖了满足三项在运行前即已确定的标准的所有 LSR-Synth 问题：真值表达式的复杂度位于其对应域的四分位距范围内，域外测试集具有信息量，并且从真值中移除任意一项后重新拟合其余各项，在训练数据上的归一化均方误差（NMSE）高于 10 − 3 10^{-3}。 所选问题包含两个化学问题（CRK21、CRK35）、一个生物学问题（BPG18）、六个物理学问题（PO0、PO1、PO7、PO10、PO16、PO26）以及三个材料科学问题（MatSci6、MatSci9、MatSci11）。

paragraphs.en: The four LLM-based methods use a common evaluator during search. A candidate is a Python function of the inputs and up to ten free constants. The evaluator traces the function into an expression tree and rejects trees with more than 30 nodes or with operators outside a fixed set. It fits the constants to the training data by least squares from a common starting point and returns the negative NMSE as the fitness. PySR retains its own search and constant fitting. For final selection, the evaluated candidates from each LLM-based run and the candidates on PySR’s Pareto front undergo the same refitting and selection procedure. We construct the Pareto front of training error against node count, retain candidates whose error is at most 1.5 1.5 times the minimum, and select the one with the highest PySR score [ 19 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 四种基于大语言模型的方法在搜索过程中使用同一个评估器。 候选解是一个以输入和最多十个自由常数为参数的 Python 函数。 评估器将该函数追踪为表达式树，并拒绝节点数超过 30 或使用固定算子集之外算子的表达式树。 评估器从共同的起点出发，用最小二乘法将常数拟合到训练数据上，并返回负 NMSE 作为适应度。 PySR 保留其自身的搜索和常数拟合机制。 在最终选择阶段，来自各基于大语言模型运行的已评估候选解与 PySR 帕累托前沿上的候选解经历相同的重新拟合和选择流程。 我们构建训练误差对节点数的帕累托前沿，保留误差不超过最小值 1.5 倍的候选解，并选出 PySR 得分最高的那一个 [ 19 ] 。

sents.en: We construct the Pareto front of training error against node count, retain candidates whose error is at most 1.5 1.5 times the minimum, and select the one with the highest PySR score [ 19 ] .
sents.zh: 我们构建训练误差对节点数的帕累托前沿，保留误差不超过最小值 1.5 倍的候选解，并选出 PySR 得分最高的那一个 [ 19 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We assess whether each selected equation recovers the ground truth exactly or with negligible extra terms (Section S3-A). An equation is exact when it is algebraically equivalent to the ground truth up to reparameterization of the constants. Extra terms are negligible when their amplitude on the training data remains below 10 − 3 10^{-3} of the target’s standard deviation. We also record whether an exact equation appeared anywhere in the run’s candidate set. In the three material-science problems, the two inputs are coupled along T = 273 + 500 ​ ε T=273+500\varepsilon in every split, so the data cannot separate their effects. We therefore assess recovery against the ground truth reduced along this trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估每个被选中的方程是精确恢复了真值，还是仅带有可忽略的额外项（第 S3-A 节）。 当一个方程在常数重新参数化的意义下与真值代数等价时，即为精确方程。 当额外项在训练数据上的幅值保持在目标标准差的 10 − 3 10^{-3} 以下时，即为可忽略。 我们还记录精确方程是否出现在该次运行的候选集合中的任何位置。 在三个材料科学问题中，两个输入在每个数据划分里都沿着 T = 273 + 500 ​ ε T=273+500\varepsilon 耦合，因此数据无法区分它们各自的作用。 因此，我们沿该轨迹对真值进行约化后，再据此评估恢复效果。

paragraphs.en: The four LLM-based methods follow the LLM-SRBench budget of up to 1000 model requests per problem. AgenticEvolve and No-analysis use three islands, each stopping at 333 commits, 333 requests or five consecutive turns without a tool call, whichever comes first. AgenticEvolve may run up to ten analyses per commit. LLM-SR draws 1000 samples per problem, and SR-Scientist runs up to 40 rounds of at most 25 model messages. Both retain their original search procedures but use the common evaluator (Section S1-C). This changes their constant fitting: on CRK21, LLM-SR’s original BFGS routine leaves a substantially higher training error than least squares even when given the ground-truth expression. PySR uses the settings published by SR-Scientist, including a limit of 30 nodes. The four LLM-based methods use DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with high reasoning effort, and costs are calculated using the prices in Section IV . To keep the five-method comparison within our computational budget, we run each method once per problem.
paragraphs.zh: 四种基于大语言模型的方法遵循 LLM-SRBench 的预算，即每个问题最多 1000 次模型请求。 AgenticEvolve 和 No-analysis 使用三个岛屿，每个岛屿在达到 333 次提交、333 次请求或连续五轮未调用工具时停止，以先到者为准。 AgenticEvolve 每次提交最多可运行十次分析。 LLM-SR 对每个问题抽取 1000 个样本，SR-Scientist 最多运行 40 轮、每轮最多 25 条模型消息。 两者均保留其原有搜索流程，但使用统一的评估器（第 S1-C 节）。 这改变了它们的常数拟合方式：在 CRK21 上，即使给定真值表达式，LLM-SR 原有的 BFGS 例程所得的训练误差仍远高于最小二乘法。 PySr 采用 SR-Scientist 公布的设置，包括 30 个节点的限制。 四种基于大语言模型的方法均使用 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 并采用高推理强度，成本按第 IV 节中的价格计算。 为了将五种方法的比较控制在我们的计算预算之内，我们对每个问题各运行一次每种方法。

paragraphs.en: At comparable total cost, AgenticEvolve recovers the structure of more equations than SR-Scientist. The two methods spend 6.5 and 6.6 USD over the twelve problems (Table III ) and recover eleven and six equations exactly or with negligible extra terms. No-analysis spends 12.1 USD, roughly twice as much as AgenticEvolve, and LLM-SR spends 111 USD. Output tokens account for almost all of LLM-SR’s cost: its 12000 samples produce 185 million output tokens, 99% of them reasoning, compared with 7 to 13 million for each of the other three LLM-based methods (Section S3-D). Like OpenEvolve in Section V , LLM-SR has no execution tools, and DeepSeek reasons at length in each request.
paragraphs.zh: 在总成本相当的情况下，AgenticEvolve 恢复出正确结构的方程数量多于 SR-Scientist。 在这十二个问题上，两种方法分别花费 6.5 和 6.6 美元（表 III），并精确或以可忽略的额外项恢复出十一个和六个方程。 No-analysis 花费 12.1 美元，约为 AgenticEvolve 的两倍，而 LLM-SR 花费 111 美元。 输出 token 构成了 LLM-SR 成本的几乎全部：其 12000 个样本产生了 1.85 亿个输出 token，其中 99% 为推理 token，而其他三种基于 LLM 的方法各仅产生 700 万到 1300 万个（见 S3-D 节）。 与第 V 节中的 OpenEvolve 一样，LLM-SR 没有执行工具，并且 DeepSeek 在每次请求中都进行长篇推理。

When ω \omega is also free, the common optimizer converges to an incorrect frequency from its default starting point. Every method that submitted this form with a free ω \omega obtained an NMSE between 0.93 and 0.97. Each AgenticEvolve island used analysis to scan trial frequencies, fit the remaining coefficients at each frequency, and refine the frequency giving the lowest error. paragraphs.en: The analysis tool lets the agent design its own procedure for the problem at hand. In the trajectory of Section V-D , the agent measured where Best Fit wastes capacity, estimated the expected final waste of a bin, built a placement rule from the estimate and optimized the rule locally before submitting it. On BPG18, it treated the frequency as a separate search problem because the common optimizer struggled to fit it. It scanned trial frequencies on the training data and submitted an expression with the fitted frequency fixed. In both cases, analysis provided the information and computation used to construct the candidate, which the agent tested locally before submitting it for formal evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 该分析工具允许智能体为当前问题自行设计解题流程。 在第V-D节的轨迹中，智能体测量了Best Fit在何处浪费容量，估计了箱子的期望最终浪费量，基于该估计构建了一个放置规则，并在提交前对该规则进行了局部优化。 在BPG18上，它将频率视为一个独立的搜索问题，因为通用优化器难以拟合该频率。 它在训练数据上扫描了试验频率，并提交了一个将拟合频率固定下来的表达式。 在这两个案例中，分析提供了用于构建候选方案的信息与计算，智能体在提交进行正式评估前先在本地对其进行了测试。

paragraphs.en: What the analysis can establish depends on the data the task exposes. In symbolic regression, the agent can inspect the training data directly and design computations such as the frequency scan on BPG18. It can also fit and score a candidate on the same data as the evaluator. Formal evaluation therefore checks a candidate whose training performance the agent can already assess locally. In heuristic optimization, the evaluation instances are hidden. The agent generates its own instances from the stated distribution, and improvements on these instances must still be verified on the hidden set. The case in Section V-D illustrates this transfer, and the results in Section V show that AgenticEvolve’s improvements hold on both hidden and unseen instances with every model.
paragraphs.zh: 分析所能确立的内容取决于任务所暴露的数据。 在符号回归中，智能体可以直接查看训练数据，并设计诸如在 BPG18 上进行频率扫描之类的计算。 它还可以在与评估器相同的数据上拟合候选解并为其打分。 因此，形式化评估所检验的候选解，其训练性能智能体已经能够在本地进行评估。 在启发式优化中，评估实例是隐藏的。 智能体根据所声明的分布自行生成实例，而在这些实例上的改进仍必须在隐藏集上进行验证。 第 V-D 节中的案例说明了这种迁移，第 V 节中的结果表明，AgenticEvolve 的改进在所有模型上都能在隐藏实例和未见实例上保持有效。

paragraphs.en: Prompt caching makes the persistent conversation affordable. Each request resends the conversation, which grows with every analysis, so an AgenticEvolve run sends 24 to 164 times as many input tokens as an OpenEvolve run. With 99% of these tokens served from cache, AgenticEvolve’s mean cost ranges from 0.6 to 4.5 USD per run across models and tasks. Cached input accounts for about a third of this cost with DeepSeek and about four fifths with GLM and Qwen, whose cache-read prices are higher than DeepSeek’s. Without execution tools, the model produces far more reasoning tokens. With DeepSeek, OpenEvolve generates 15 to 27 thousand output tokens per request, compared with about one thousand for AgenticEvolve, making OpenEvolve more expensive despite its shorter prompts. For the same reason, LLM-SR costs seventeen times as much as AgenticEvolve in symbolic regression. Persistent conversations also require management of the limited context window. In 15 of the 30 AgenticEvolve heuristic runs, at least one session reached the compaction threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词缓存使得持久化对话在成本上可承受。 每次请求都会重发对话内容，而对话随每次分析不断增长，因此一次 AgenticEvolve 运行发送的输入令牌数量是 OpenEvolve 运行的 24 到 164 倍。 由于这些令牌中 99% 由缓存提供，AgenticEvolve 在不同模型和任务下的平均成本为每次运行 0.6 到 4.5 美元。 缓存输入约占该成本的三分之一（使用 DeepSeek 时），在使用 GLM 和 Qwen 时约占五分之四，因为这两个模型的缓存读取价格高于 DeepSeek。 在没有执行工具的情况下，模型会产生多得多的推理令牌。 使用 DeepSeek 时，OpenEvolve 每次请求生成 1.5 万到 2.7 万个输出令牌，而 AgenticEvolve 约为一千个，尽管 OpenEvolve 的提示词更短，其成本却更高。 出于同样的原因，在符号回归任务中，LLM-SR 的成本是 AgenticEvolve 的十七倍。 持久化对话还需要管理有限的上下文窗口。 在 30 次 AgenticEvolve 启发式运行中，有 15 次至少有一个会话达到了压缩阈值。

paragraphs.en: Execution inside the candidate program provides another means of computation that the evaluation protocol must account for. Four of the 90 final heuristic programs tune their parameters at import time within a wall-clock limit, making their scores sensitive to the load on the evaluating machine. Re-evaluation changed the score of one of them by less than 10 − 3 10^{-3} and left the other three unchanged. The feedback restriction in Section III-D followed an earlier No-analysis run on BPG18 in which a candidate located the training data using an evaluator path exposed in a traceback. Only the No-analysis runs were repeated under the restriction. In the final runs, agents still attempted to access hidden data through analysis scripts and candidate programs. The audit found no successful access (Section S4). Both types of code run as ordinary host processes, so access restrictions are protocol-level and compliance is checked by audit. Enforcing file-access boundaries would require an operating-system sandbox with explicit access controls.
paragraphs.zh: 在候选程序内部执行提供了另一种计算方式，评估协议必须将这一因素纳入考量。 90个最终启发式程序中有4个在墙钟时间限制内于导入时调整其参数，使其得分对评估机器的负载敏感。 重新评估使其中一个的得分变化小于10^{-3}，另外三个保持不变。 第III-D节中的反馈限制源于早先在BPG18上的一次无分析（No-analysis）运行，其中某个候选程序利用回溯信息中暴露的评估器路径定位了训练数据。 只有无分析运行是在该限制下重复进行的。 在最终运行中，智能体仍试图通过分析脚本和候选程序访问隐藏数据。 审计未发现任何成功访问（见第S4节）。 两类代码都作为普通宿主进程运行，因此访问限制属于协议层面，其合规性通过审计来检查。 要强制实施文件访问边界，则需要一个具有显式访问控制机制的操作系统沙箱。

paragraphs.en: Agents used the archive and migration to inspect and build on other islands’ programs, although the effect of these mechanisms was not measured in isolation. Every AgenticEvolve heuristic run included reads of programs from other islands, and about a quarter of the candidates offered through migration were read. Of the 215 commits preceded by a cross-island read, 169 improved the island’s best score and 29 improved the run’s best score (Section S2-D). In one OBP run with Qwen, the agent adopted a neighboring island’s value table and extended its rule for opening a new bin, identifying the source in its commit description. These observations associate cross-island reads with subsequent improvements, but do not establish the effect of migration. That would require a comparison with migration disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体利用存档和迁移来查看并借鉴其他岛屿的程序，但这些机制的效果并未被单独测量。 在每一次 AgenticEvolve 启发式运行中，都包含对来自其他岛屿的程序的读取，且通过迁移提供的候选中约有四分之一被读取过。 在 215 次伴随跨岛屿读取的提交中，169 次提升了所在岛屿的最佳得分，29 次提升了该次运行的最佳得分（第 S2-D 节）。 在一次使用 Qwen 的 OBP 运行中，智能体采用了邻近岛屿的取值表，并扩展了其开启新箱子（bin）的规则，并在其提交描述中注明了来源。 这些观察将跨岛屿读取与随后的改进联系起来，但并未确立迁移的效果。 若要确立这一点，则需要在禁用迁移的情况下进行比较。

sents.en: In one OBP run with Qwen, the agent adopted a neighboring island’s value table and extended its rule for opening a new bin, identifying the source in its commit description.
sents.zh: 在一次使用 Qwen 的 OBP 运行中，智能体采用了邻近岛屿的取值表，并扩展了其开启新箱子（bin）的规则，并在其提交描述中注明了来源。

sents.en: These observations associate cross-island reads with subsequent improvements, but do not establish the effect of migration.
sents.zh: 这些观察将跨岛屿读取与随后的改进联系起来，但并未确立迁移的效果。

sents.en: That would require a comparison with migration disabled.
sents.zh: 若要确立这一点，则需要在禁用迁移的情况下进行比较。

paragraphs.en: We presented AgenticEvolve, an evolutionary program search framework in which a persistent LLM agent conducts the search on each island and runs experiments between formal evaluations. On two heuristic design tasks, these experiments raised final program quality with all three models, and the improvement carried over to unseen instances. AgenticEvolve reached the quality of No-analysis (with experiments disabled) and OpenEvolve with a fraction of their formal evaluations. Prompt caching kept the cost of its persistent conversation within a few USD per run. In equation discovery, where the agent can inspect the data, AgenticEvolve recovered more benchmark equations than No-analysis, LLM-SR, SR-Scientist and PySR. In both settings, the agent designed experiments to guide candidate construction, using self-generated instances for heuristic optimization and the available data for equation discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AgenticEvolve，一个演化式程序搜索框架，其中持久的 LLM 智能体在每个岛屿上执行搜索，并在正式评估之间运行实验。 在两个启发式设计任务上，这些实验在所有三个模型上都提升了最终程序质量，并且这种改进迁移到了未见过的实例上。 AgenticEvolve 以其正式评估次数的一小部分，达到了 No-analysis（禁用实验）和 OpenEvolve 的质量。 提示缓存使其持久对话的成本保持在每次运行几美元以内。 在方程发现任务中，智能体可以查看数据，AgenticEvolve 比起 No-analysis、LLM-SR、SR-Scientist 和 PySR 恢复出了更多基准方程。 在两种设置中，智能体都设计了实验来引导候选解的构建，在启发式优化中使用自生成的实例，在方程发现中使用可用的数据。

A persistent agent reads the archive, chooses which program to build on and runs its own experiments before submitting a candidate. paragraphs.en: AgenticEvolve and OpenEvolve use the same generation parameters for each model. AgenticEvolve uses the providers’ default temperature of 1.0, while OpenEvolve sets the temperature explicitly to the same value. DeepSeek ignores the temperature in thinking mode. paragraphs.en: Request handling differs between the two systems. AgenticEvolve includes tool schemas in its requests and streams each response, with a timeout of 300 seconds between streamed chunks. OpenEvolve uses non-streaming requests and includes a random seed. Its timeout applies to the entire request and is set to 1200 seconds to accommodate DeepSeek’s reasoning, which takes about five minutes on OpenEvolve’s prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 两个系统在请求处理上有所不同。 AgenticEvolve 在请求中包含工具模式（tool schemas），并对每个响应进行流式传输，流式数据块之间的超时时间为 300 秒。 OpenEvolve 使用非流式请求，并包含一个随机种子。 其超时时间适用于整个请求，设置为 1200 秒，以容纳 DeepSeek 的推理过程——在 OpenEvolve 的提示词上，该推理大约需要五分钟。

paragraphs.en: AgenticEvolve limits the conversation context to 500000 tokens. When the context exceeds 70% of this limit, the next commit feedback asks the agent to end its turn, after which the framework compacts the conversation (Section III-B ). At 90% the framework cancels the turn immediately. Compaction occurred 25 times across 15 of the 30 AgenticEvolve heuristic runs. No-analysis never reached the threshold.
paragraphs.zh: AgenticEvolve 将对话上下文限制在 500000 个 token 以内。 当上下文超过该限制的 70% 时，下一次提交反馈会要求智能体结束其回合，随后框架对对话进行压缩（第 III-B 节）。 达到 90% 时，框架会立即取消该回合。 在 30 次 AgenticEvolve 启发式运行中，有 15 次共发生了 25 次压缩。 No-analysis 从未达到该阈值。

paragraphs.en: We retain three differences between OpenEvolve and AgenticEvolve as part of the system comparison. OpenEvolve rescales each feature using the minimum and maximum observed so far before assigning it to a bin, whereas AgenticEvolve uses the evaluator’s fixed normalization. An OpenEvolve iteration whose response contains no valid diff consumes a model request without an evaluation. We therefore count formal evaluations in the evaluator adapter rather than use the iteration count. OpenEvolve’s prompt shows metrics to four decimal places, whereas AgenticEvolve shows them unrounded.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在系统对比中保留了 OpenEvolve 与 AgenticEvolve 之间的三个差异。 OpenEvolve 在将每个特征分配到分箱之前，会使用迄今为止观测到的最小值和最大值对其进行重新缩放，而 AgenticEvolve 则使用评估器的固定归一化。 OpenEvolve 中响应不包含有效 diff 的迭代会消耗一次模型请求而没有进行评估。 因此，我们在评估器适配器中统计正式评估的次数，而不是使用迭代次数。 OpenEvolve 的提示词将指标显示到小数点后四位，而 AgenticEvolve 则显示未舍入的数值。

Its search is unchanged, with ten islands, two example programs and four samples per prompt, and a time limit of 30 seconds per evaluation. Our model client replaces the repository’s client, which caps every response at 1024 tokens and records no token usage.

paragraphs.en: We use the SR-Scientist inference code at commit 00a44a1. Its search is unchanged, with 40 rounds of at most 25 model messages, an error target that tightens from round to round, and the three best candidates carried into the next round. The evaluator tool and the re-evaluation at the end of each round both use the shared evaluator in place of the original BFGS fitting procedure. The system prompt and tool description state the shared evaluation rules. The data analysis tool executes the model’s code in a local subprocess that receives the training data on standard input, replacing the original remote sandbox service. Our model client replaces the original client, which caps every response at 8192 tokens and records no token usage. The replacement clients for both LLM-SR and SR-Scientist use the model’s maximum output length and high reasoning effort, matching AgenticEvolve.

paragraphs.en: Table S6 summarizes cross-island reads in the 30 AgenticEvolve heuristic runs, supporting the observations in Section VII of the paper. For each receiving island, a migration candidate is counted as offered when it first appears in the migration feedback, provided the island commits at least once afterwards. It is counted as read if the agent subsequently retrieves its program with read_commit . Each cross-island read is associated with the next commit, allowing for intervening analyses and edits. A commit improves the island’s or run’s best score if it exceeds the corresponding best score before that commit, including the initial program’s score.
paragraphs.zh: 表 S6 总结了 30 次 AgenticEvolve 启发式运行中的跨岛读取情况，支持了论文第七节中的观察结果。 对于每个接收岛，只要迁移候选首次出现在迁移反馈中，且该岛此后至少提交一次，该候选即计为已提供。 如果智能体随后使用 read_commit 检索其程序，则该候选计为已读取。 每次跨岛读取都与下一次提交相关联，允许其间进行分析和编辑。 如果某次提交超过了该提交之前对应的最优分数（包括初始程序的分数），则该提交改进了该岛或该次运行的最优分数。

paragraphs.en: In seven runs the candidate set contains an exact equation, but the selected equation has negligible extra terms. Five are AgenticEvolve runs on CRK35, PO0, PO16, MatSci9 and MatSci6. In each of these runs, the exact equation is the smallest candidate evaluated and lies on the Pareto front. The PySR score measures the decrease in log error per added node relative to the next smaller candidate on the front. The smallest candidate has no smaller member for comparison and is assigned a score of zero. All candidates on these fronts have training errors at the level of numerical round-off and within 1.5 times the minimum error, so all are eligible for selection. Larger candidates with slightly lower errors receive positive scores, and the candidate with the highest score is selected. paragraphs.en: Two No-analysis runs on OBP deliberately used failed evaluations to return computed values. In the DeepSeek run, island 0 first tested whether an exception message would be returned. In the GLM run, the program returned its internal counters in an exception message at the last call of the formal evaluation. Neither returned item sizes or other hidden-instance data. Printed output was never returned, although 156 No-analysis programs on OBP contain print statements.
paragraphs.zh: 在 OBP 上的两次 No-analysis 运行故意利用失败的评估来返回计算出的值。 在 DeepSeek 运行中，岛 0 首先测试是否会返回异常消息。 随后它在导入时对自生成的序列模拟了约 150 条规则，并在异常消息中返回这些规则的排名。 在 GLM 运行中，该程序在正式评估的最后一次调用时于异常消息中返回了其内部计数器。 两者都没有返回条目大小或其他隐藏实例的数据。 尽管 OBP 上有 156 个 No-analysis 程序包含打印语句，但打印输出从未被返回。

sents.zh: 在 OBP 上的两次 No-analysis 运行故意利用失败的评估来返回计算出的值。

sents.en: In the DeepSeek run, island 0 first tested whether an exception message would be returned.
sents.zh: 在 DeepSeek 运行中，岛 0 首先测试是否会返回异常消息。

sents.en: It then simulated about 150 rules on self-generated sequences at import time and returned their rankings in exception messages.
sents.zh: 随后它在导入时对自生成的序列模拟了约 150 条规则，并在异常消息中返回这些规则的排名。

sents.zh: 在 GLM 运行中，该程序在正式评估的最后一次调用时于异常消息中返回了其内部计数器。

sents.zh: 两者都没有返回条目大小或其他隐藏实例的数据。

sents.zh: 尽管 OBP 上有 156 个 No-analysis 程序包含打印语句，但打印输出从未被返回。

paragraphs.en: Three AgenticEvolve analyses attempted to reconstruct the hidden instances from the returned metrics by scanning random seeds or decoding rule R1. All three failed. One GLM run on OBP claimed to reproduce the hidden sequences from a particular seed, but only 1.1% of its item values matched the hidden sequences, consistent with chance.
paragraphs.zh: 三次 AgenticEvolve 分析试图通过扫描随机种子或解码规则 R1 从返回的指标中重建隐藏实例。三次均失败。 一次在 OBP 上运行的 GLM 声称通过特定种子复现了隐藏序列，但其条目值仅有 1.1% 与隐藏序列匹配，与随机水平一致。

sents.zh: 三次 AgenticEvolve 分析试图通过扫描随机种子或解码规则 R1 从返回的指标中重建隐藏实例。三次均失败。

sents.en: One GLM run on OBP claimed to reproduce the hidden sequences from a particular seed, but only 1.1% of its item values matched the hidden sequences, consistent with chance.
sents.zh: 一次在 OBP 上运行的 GLM 声称通过特定种子复现了隐藏序列，但其条目值仅有 1.1% 与隐藏序列匹配，与随机水平一致。

paragraphs.en: No heuristic run used the evaluator path, read files outside its temporary directory or reconstructed the hidden instances.
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何启发式运行使用评估器路径、读取其临时目录之外的文件，或重建隐藏实例。

paragraphs.en: AgenticEvolve, LLM-SR, SR-Scientist and PySR ran on framework version 0.2.0. The reported No-analysis runs used version 0.2.1, which introduced the feedback restriction and a check when loading candidates. This check rejects candidates that import modules other than NumPy and math, call file or code-execution functions, or use double-underscore names.
paragraphs.zh: AgenticEvolve、LLM-SR、SR-Scientist 和 PySR 运行于框架版本 0.2.0。 所报告的无分析运行使用的是版本 0.2.1，该版本引入了反馈限制以及加载候选时的检查。 此检查会拒绝导入 NumPy 和 math 之外模块、调用文件或代码执行函数，或使用双下划线名称的候选。

sents.en: AgenticEvolve, LLM-SR, SR-Scientist and PySR ran on framework version 0.2.0.
sents.zh: AgenticEvolve、LLM-SR、SR-Scientist 和 PySR 运行于框架版本 0.2.0。

sents.en: The reported No-analysis runs used version 0.2.1, which introduced the feedback restriction and a check when loading candidates.
sents.zh: 所报告的无分析运行使用的是版本 0.2.1，该版本引入了反馈限制以及加载候选时的检查。

sents.en: This check rejects candidates that import modules other than NumPy and math, call file or code-execution functions, or use double-underscore names.
sents.zh: 此检查会拒绝导入 NumPy 和 math 之外模块、调用文件或代码执行函数，或使用双下划线名称的候选。

paragraphs.en: The evaluator calls every candidate with symbolic inputs and fits the resulting expression itself, so candidates never receive data values. They can access data only by reading files or process memory. The test sets and ground truth are stored in the benchmark’s dataset cache on the host and are absent from all task and run directories. Table S10 lists the data each method’s code is permitted to use and its feedback on evaluation failure. PySR executes no model-written code and was excluded from the audit.
paragraphs.zh: 评估器使用符号化输入调用每个智能体，并由其自行拟合生成的表达式，因此智能体永远不会接收到数据值。 它们只能通过读取文件或进程内存来访问数据。 测试集和真值存储在宿主机的基准数据集缓存中，所有任务目录和运行目录中均不存在。 表 S10 列出了每种方法的代码被允许使用的数据及其在评估失败时的反馈。 PySR 不执行任何由模型编写的代码，因此被排除在审计之外。

sents.zh: 表 S10 列出了每种方法的代码被允许使用的数据及其在评估失败时的反馈。

paragraphs.en: The audit covers 316 AgenticEvolve evaluations and 1857 analyses, 3988 No-analysis evaluations, 12012 LLM-SR samples, and 66 SR-Scientist candidates with 5211 executions of its analysis tool. A further 210 analysis calls and 5 evaluator calls requested by SR-Scientist were never executed because the round had reached its message limit.
paragraphs.zh: 该审计涵盖 316 次 AgenticEvolve 评估与 1857 条分析、3988 次 No-analysis 评估、12012 个 LLM-SR 样本，以及 66 个 SR-Scientist 候选方案及其分析工具的 5211 次执行。 SR-Scientist 请求的另外 210 次分析调用和 5 次评估器调用因该轮次已达到消息上限而从未被执行。

sents.en: The audit covers 316 AgenticEvolve evaluations and 1857 analyses, 3988 No-analysis evaluations, 12012 LLM-SR samples, and 66 SR-Scientist candidates with 5211 executions of its analysis tool.
sents.zh: 该审计涵盖 316 次 AgenticEvolve 评估与 1857 条分析、3988 次 No-analysis 评估、12012 个 LLM-SR 样本，以及 66 个 SR-Scientist 候选方案及其分析工具的 5211 次执行。

sents.en: A further 210 analysis calls and 5 evaluator calls requested by SR-Scientist were never executed because the round had reached its message limit.
sents.zh: SR-Scientist 请求的另外 210 次分析调用和 5 次评估器调用因该轮次已达到消息上限而从未被执行。

paragraphs.en: Fourteen commits in six No-analysis runs attempted to obtain values from the evaluation. Thirteen used print statements or exceptions to return markers, input statistics or parameters. One also attempted to load the training file at import time from three guessed relative paths. None returned data: the inputs were symbolic, printed output was withheld, and the evaluation directory contained no data file. After each attempt, the agent noted that no output had been returned and resumed the search. No BPG18 commit read or listed a file. The frequency on BPG18 was recovered through successive trial values guided by the returned NMSE (Section VI ).
paragraphs.zh: 在六次无分析运行中，共有十四次提交试图从评估中获取数值。 其中十三次使用打印语句或异常来返回标记、输入统计信息或参数。 一次还尝试在导入时从三个猜测的相对路径加载训练文件。 没有一次返回数据：输入是符号化的，打印输出被扣留，评估目录中也没有数据文件。 在每次尝试之后，智能体注意到没有返回任何输出，并继续搜索。 没有任何 BPG18 提交读取或列出过文件。 BPG18 上的频率是通过根据返回的 NMSE 指导的连续试探值恢复出来的（第 VI 节）。

sents.zh: 在六次无分析运行中，共有十四次提交试图从评估中获取数值。

sents.zh: 其中十三次使用打印语句或异常来返回标记、输入统计信息或参数。

sents.zh: 在每次尝试之后，智能体注意到没有返回任何输出，并继续搜索。

sents.zh: 没有任何 BPG18 提交读取或列出过文件。

sents.en: The frequency on BPG18 was recovered through successive trial values guided by the returned NMSE (Section VI ).
sents.zh: BPG18 上的频率是通过根据返回的 NMSE 指导的连续试探值恢复出来的（第 VI 节）。

paragraphs.en: No AgenticEvolve candidate program accessed a file. In five runs, analysis scripts searched their own directory for test data or metadata about the ground truth and found only the training data. On PO0, a failed evaluation exposed the evaluator’s absolute path in a traceback. An analysis script then searched for the evaluator’s source code under the host’s home and temporary directories and tried to import the evaluator, despite the system prompt’s instruction to stay within its directory. Neither attempt succeeded, and the agent did not try again.
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何 AgenticEvolve 候选程序访问过文件。 在五次运行中，分析脚本会在自身目录中搜索测试数据或关于真实答案（ground truth）的元数据，但只找到了训练数据。 在 PO0 上，一次失败的评估在错误回溯中暴露了评估器的绝对路径。 随后，一个分析脚本在宿主机的用户主目录和临时目录下搜索评估器的源代码，并尝试导入该评估器，尽管系统提示词明确要求其留在自身目录内。 这两次尝试均未成功，该智能体也没有再次尝试。

sents.en: No AgenticEvolve candidate program accessed a file.
sents.zh: 没有任何 AgenticEvolve 候选程序访问过文件。

sents.en: In five runs, analysis scripts searched their own directory for test data or metadata about the ground truth and found only the training data.
sents.zh: 在五次运行中，分析脚本会在自身目录中搜索测试数据或关于真实答案（ground truth）的元数据，但只找到了训练数据。

sents.en: On PO0, a failed evaluation exposed the evaluator’s absolute path in a traceback.
sents.zh: 在 PO0 上，一次失败的评估在错误回溯中暴露了评估器的绝对路径。

sents.en: An analysis script then searched for the evaluator’s source code under the host’s home and temporary directories and tried to import the evaluator, despite the system prompt’s instruction to stay within its directory.
sents.zh: 随后，一个分析脚本在宿主机的用户主目录和临时目录下搜索评估器的源代码，并尝试导入该评估器，尽管系统提示词明确要求其留在自身目录内。

sents.zh: 这两次尝试均未成功，该智能体也没有再次尝试。

paragraphs.en: No LLM-SR sample imports modules, performs file or process operations, uses introspection or outputs values. Samples execute in a forked child of the driver process, which holds the current problem’s test data in memory. No sample accesses the interpreter internals through which those data could be reached. SR-Scientist’s analysis code reads the training data from standard input as instructed, and neither its analyses nor its candidates read files or refer to host paths.
paragraphs.zh: 没有 LLM-SR 样本导入模块、执行文件或进程操作、使用内省或输出数值。 样本在驱动进程的派生子进程中执行，该进程将当前问题的测试数据保存在内存中。 没有样本访问可触及这些数据的解释器内部结构。 SR-Scientist 的分析代码按要求从标准输入读取训练数据，其分析和候选解均不读取文件或引用宿主机路径。

sents.zh: 没有 LLM-SR 样本导入模块、执行文件或进程操作、使用内省或输出数值。

paragraphs.en: The original No-analysis runs under version 0.2.0 were replaced. On BPG18, a candidate on island 2 raised an error whose traceback revealed the evaluator’s absolute path. Subsequent candidates on that island searched the task directory, loaded the training file and returned the results of frequency scans and least-squares fits in exception messages. The recovered frequency reached the other two islands through migration. Candidates in six other runs tried relative paths or listed directories without finding the file. These attempts prompted the feedback restriction and candidate load check introduced in version 0.2.1.
paragraphs.zh: 原先 No-analysis 在 0.2.0 版本下运行的结果已被替换。 在 BPG18 上，岛屿 2 上的一个候选智能体引发了一个错误，其回溯信息暴露了评估器的绝对路径。 该岛屿上的后续候选智能体搜索了任务目录，加载了训练文件，并在异常消息中返回了频率扫描和最小二乘拟合的结果。 恢复出的频率通过迁移传到了另外两个岛屿。 另有六次运行中的候选智能体尝试使用相对路径或列出目录内容，但都未找到该文件。 这些尝试促使 0.2.1 版本引入了反馈限制和候选智能体加载检查。

sents.zh: 原先 No-analysis 在 0.2.0 版本下运行的结果已被替换。

sents.en: On BPG18, a candidate on island 2 raised an error whose traceback revealed the evaluator’s absolute path.
sents.zh: 在 BPG18 上，岛屿 2 上的一个候选智能体引发了一个错误，其回溯信息暴露了评估器的绝对路径。

sents.zh: 恢复出的频率通过迁移传到了另外两个岛屿。

sents.en: Candidates in six other runs tried relative paths or listed directories without finding the file.
sents.zh: 另有六次运行中的候选智能体尝试使用相对路径或列出目录内容，但都未找到该文件。

sents.en: These attempts prompted the feedback restriction and candidate load check introduced in version 0.2.1.
sents.zh: 这些尝试促使 0.2.1 版本引入了反馈限制和候选智能体加载检查。

paragraphs.en: In the final runs, no candidate program or analysis script obtained data beyond what its method was given. This conclusion is based on the recorded code, outputs and reasoning. The audit cannot exclude effects absent from these records. For LLM-SR, the records contain only the extracted function bodies, not the full model responses.
paragraphs.zh: 在最终运行中，没有任何候选程序或分析脚本获取超出其方法所给定范围的数据。 该结论基于所记录的代码、输出和推理。 该审计无法排除未出现在这些记录中的影响。 对于 LLM-SR，记录中仅包含提取出的函数体，而非完整的模型响应。
